rawFindings.title: Accessing node.id.type without verifying node.id in VariableDeclarator
rawFindings.explanation: At added line 151, the condition in VariableDeclarator listener was changed to add a check for node.id.type === "Identifier", but the check is done without verifying if node.id exists, which could cause runtime errors if node.id is null or undefined.
rawFindings.suggestion: Add a nullish check for node.id before accessing node.id.type, such as node.id && node.id.type === "Identifier".
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Input code with a VariableDeclarator node where node.init.type is 'FunctionExpression' but node.id is null causes runtime error due to accessing node.id.type.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect call to isIdentifier missing ecmaVersion argument in AssignmentExpression
rawFindings.explanation: At added line 160, inside AssignmentExpression listener, the isIdentifier function is called as isIdentifier(name), but isIdentifier expects two arguments: name and ecmaVersion. The absence of ecmaVersion leads to inconsistent validation of identifiers.
rawFindings.suggestion: Pass ecmaVersion to isIdentifier call: isIdentifier(name, ecmaVersion).
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: AssignmentExpression with computed property name string literal that fails to be recognized as an identifier due to missing ecmaVersion argument, causing incorrect warning behavior.
